Appendix table 10. Adults on parole, by jurisdiction, 2021

column12: Number on parole per 100,000 adult U.S. residents, December 31, 2021/b

column1: Note: Due to nonresponse or incomplete data, the parole population for some jurisdictions on December 31, 2021 does not equal the population on January 1, 2021 plus entries, minus exits. Counts may not be actual as reporting agencies may provide estimates on some or all detailed data.
a/Imputed counts differ from reported counts in jurisdictions where data were not available. Details may not sum to totals due to rounding.

b/Rates are based on parole counts as of December 31 of the reporting year and calculated using U.S. Census Bureau estimates of U.S. residents age 18 or older for January 1 of the following year in each jurisdiction.
c/Includes estimates of adults on post-release community supervision and mandatory supervision: 55,220 on January 1, 2021 and 55,220 on December 31, 2021.
d/Data for parole entries and exits are subject to fluctuation. See Parole: Explanatory notes for 2021 for details.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Annual Parole Survey, 2021; and U.S. Census Bureau, National Intercensal Estimates, 2022.
